title: Repo Shelf article
description: One Japanese repository recommendation per JSON file. All prose is plain text; Markdown is not rendered. The content.mjs runtime validator is the authoritative build gate.
$comment: Runtime-only checks: filename must be a lowercase kebab-case basename equal to slug + '.json'; slug and repository must be unique ignoring case across all files, including drafts; tags must be unique ignoring case; sources must include a safe HTTPS github.com URL whose normalized repository path matches repository ignoring case. Runtime always validates real Gregorian dates including leap years and excludes year 0000, regardless of whether a schema validator asserts format. Runtime also validates normalized URL hosts and ports, rejects symlinks/nested directories, and limits file size to 256 KiB. JSON Schema maxLength counts Unicode code points; content.mjs uses JavaScript UTF-16 code units and can therefore be stricter for characters outside the BMP. Unknown object fields are rejected, including an in-document $schema field; associate this schema through editor configuration instead.

slug.$comment: Runtime requires the exact filename '<slug>.json' and checks case-insensitive uniqueness across all records, including drafts.

repository.description: GitHub owner/name identifier. Owner is 1–39 alphanumeric or hyphen characters, with no leading, trailing, or consecutive hyphens. Name is 1–100 alphanumeric, dot, underscore, or hyphen characters, excluding '.' and '..'.
repository.$comment: Runtime checks case-insensitive repository uniqueness across every article, including drafts, and requires a matching GitHub repository source.

tags.$comment: uniqueItems catches exact duplicates. Runtime additionally rejects tags that differ only by letter case.

status.description: Only published articles appear in site output and published metrics. Drafts receive the same schema and duplicate checks.

sources.$comment: Runtime requires at least one safe HTTPS github.com source whose URL-normalized pathname, after removing one trailing slash, equals '/' + repository ignoring case. URL query strings and fragments do not affect the repository match.

plainText.description: Nonempty text without surrounding whitespace, angle brackets, HTML, or unsafe control characters. Interior tabs and line breaks are permitted. Markdown syntax remains literal text.

calendarDate.description: A real Gregorian calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format, with year 0001–9999.
calendarDate.$comment: format may be annotation-only in a JSON Schema implementation. Runtime always checks days per month and leap years. No ordering, freshness, or future-date restriction is imposed; status alone controls publication.

url.description: HTTPS source URL without whitespace, backslashes, angle brackets, or control characters.
url.$comment: Runtime uses the WHATWG URL parser and requires a DNS-style host containing a dot, with no trailing dot, IP address, credentials, non-default port, or localhost/local/internal/test/invalid suffix. Each normalized DNS label must contain only alphanumeric characters and internal hyphens and be 1–63 characters. This syntax schema is intentionally supplemented by the authoritative runtime URL checks; schema-only validation does not establish a safe source URL.
